q: What carbon data do foreign buyers ask Peenya precision component exporters for?
title: Peenya component exporters: buyer data
short: Expect Scope 1 and 2 totals with the 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh CEA factor, the share of green power and a figure per part, mostly material plus allocated machining energy. Check whether your parts fall under CBAM: steel fasteners and some steel articles do, machined assemblies of other metals usually do not.
audience: Machining, sheet metal and tool room exporters in Peenya, Bommasandra and Jigani

ul: Footprint per part or per kg.
Green tariff or rooftop solar share.

p: Machine hours per part are often fairer than weight for precision work. State the method.
A BESCOM green tariff lowers the market based figure; the location based figure stays at the national factor.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
